## Purpose
`useEconomySummary` and `useWorkspaceSummary` are the two "summary" hooks: each wraps a single `dashboard_xxx_summary`-style backend command and offers BOTH a multi-project fan-out (`useQueries`) and a single-project convenience variant in the same file. They exist so pages that show one project's rollup and pages that show every project's rollup (sidebar, overview) share one query key naming scheme and never diverge on cache identity.

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/hooks/** · Extension: .ts · Files of this role in this subproject: 2
The file exports two functions: the plural fan-out (named after the summary, e.g. `useWorkspaceSummary(projects)`) built on `useQueries`, and a `*Single` suffix or scope-based single-project variant built on plain `useQuery`, both keyed by the same `["<name>-summary", pathOrScope]`-shaped array so a fan-out row and a direct fetch of the same project share cache identity. `queryFn` return type is annotated explicitly (`(): Promise<WorkspaceSummary> => ...`) when the query key needs an `as const` cast, per `useWorkspaceSummary`.

## How to apply
A new "summary" hook needs its own backend `dashboard_xxx_summary`-shaped command (see `dashboardWorkspaceSummary` / `fetchEconomySummary` in `lib/dashboard.ts`) and a hook file exporting the plural `useQueries` fan-out plus a singular `useQuery` variant, both keyed with the summary's own name as the first array element so watcher invalidation by key-prefix keeps working.

## Examples
Ref: apps/dashboard/src/hooks/useWorkspaceSummary.ts
```ts
export function useWorkspaceSummary(projects: Project[]) {
  return useQueries({
    queries: projects.map((p) => ({
      queryKey: ["workspace-summary", p.path] as const,
      queryFn: (): Promise<WorkspaceSummary> => dashboardWorkspaceSummary(p.path),
      enabled: !!p.path,
      staleTime: 5_000,
    })),
  });
}

/** Convenience: single-project variant using plain useQuery. */
export function useWorkspaceSummarySingle(repoPath: string | null) {
  return useQuery<WorkspaceSummary>({
    queryKey: ["workspace-summary", repoPath],
    queryFn: () => dashboardWorkspaceSummary(repoPath as string),
    enabled: !!repoPath,
    staleTime: 5_000,
  });
}
```

Ref: apps/dashboard/src/hooks/useEconomySummary.ts

  return useQuery<EconomySummary>({
